Remark
[Einstein tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0123, petersen:page-0124 ↗ def:pet-ch3-ricci-curvature ↗ def:pet-ch3-scalar-curvature ↗ notation:pet-ch3-divergence-adjoint

1. ch3:3.4.16For the $(0,2)$-tensor $T=\operatorname {Ric}+b\cdot \operatorname {scal}\cdot g+cg$, $b,c\in \mathbb R$: (1) show $\nabla ^*T=0$ if $b=-\tfrac 12$ — the tensor $G=\operatorname {Ric}-\tfrac {\operatorname {scal}}2g+cg$ is the Einstein tensor, $c$ the cosmological constant; (2) if $c=0$, show $G=0$ in dimension $2$; (3) for $n>2$, show $G=0$ implies the metric is Einstein; (4) for $n>2$, show $G=0$ and $c=0$ implies the metric is Ricci flat.
